provenance.sanitized: Author email, launch-app tap intent, font payloads and raster assets were removed. Layer geometry, shape formulas, colour formulas and toggle states are retained.

actual_source_check.band: w = host width, h = host height / 1.5; the band is a RECT of width w, height h, corners 58 in the 916 x 361 reference
actual_source_check.disc_diameter: every disc ShapeModule uses shape_width $gv(h)/2$ with the source band height h, so diameter = h / 2 = host height / 3
actual_source_check.all_offsets: the root StackLayerModule and all three inner StackLayerModule layers use config_rotate_offset 180.0 on their OverlapLayerModule

background.native_port: 916 x 361 rounded band vector, corners 58, filled with the style surface; the band occupies host width and host height / 1.5

hand.native_port: one native AnalogClock hour hand: a BLACK filled circle diameter h/2 with a SWEEP gradient to the hr global #FFD71921, rotated by CLOCK_HOUR_SMOOTH plus the source 180 degree offset

label.native_port: live TextClock hh' hr' in both format slots

hand.native_port: one native AnalogClock minute hand: the paint_color toggle is 0, so the actual circle paint stays BLACK rather than bg; SWEEP to the min global #FFCBCBCB, rotated by CLOCK_MINUTE plus the source 180 degree offset

label.native_port: live TextClock mm' min' in both format slots

hand.native_port: one native AnalogClock second hand: the active CLOCK_SECOND formula was not frozen or omitted; paint_color toggle 0 keeps the actual circle BLACK, SWEEP to the sec global #FF6C696E, rotated by the native second angle plus the source 180 degree offset

label.native_port: live TextClock ss' sec' in both format slots

native_port.clock: three android.widget.AnalogClock views, one per disc; each wires only its own hand and uses the same 277 x 277 transparent vector for the dial and the two unused hands
native_port.equal_intrinsic: every Future drawable is 277 x 277, so the platform clock never applies a different intrinsic scale to one layer
native_port.gradient: Android sweep shaders start at 3 o'clock and turn clockwise, the same direction as the native AnalogClock canvas rotation; the vector group 180 degree rotation applies the source config_rotate_offset exactly
native_port.api_gate: android:hand_second only in layout-v31; the receiver is disabled below API 31 by kwgt_analog_seconds_available and the catalog marks the entry unavailable
native_port.tap: source launch-app intent removed; the native provider uses ACTION_SHOW_ALARMS

uncertainties.font: The author font is not bundled; the labels use the Android platform sans-serif family, and no source font payload or raster asset is included.
uncertainties.wallpaper_colour: RemoteViews cannot safely sample the wallpaper, so the three Dotwel styles use fixed documented surfaces instead of the bg/fg darkmode formula at runtime.
uncertainties.label_gap: The source stacks the text directly after each disc with a -12 margin. The native layout uses equal vertical thirds for the band spacer, disc and label so the label cannot overrun the host; this is a documented responsive adaptation.
uncertainties.non_square_host: The AnalogClock uses its 277 intrinsic size and only downscales when the host is smaller. The middle third bounds each disc so the native diameter never exceeds the source h/2 and never overruns the host; pixel parity on every launcher is not verified in this runner.
